title: Can I use augo if I coach myself?
seoTitle: Using augo as a Self-Coached Athlete | augo support
description: augo is built around the coach–athlete relationship. Self-coached athletes can create both a coach and an athlete account and connect them.
summary: augo is designed around a coach and an athlete working together, so there is no dedicated self-coached mode. If you coach yourself, create a coach account and an athlete account and connect them to each other — you then get the assistant, feedback trends and priorities on your own training.
questionForms: can i use augo without a coach
can i coach myself with augo
i dont have a coach can i still use it
do i need a coach to use augo
can i be my own coach on augo
im self coached is augo for me

body.html: The short answer: yes, but not directly. augo’s experience is built around two people — a coach who needs context on their athletes, and an athlete who needs a place to report back. Athletes are connected through their coach, not independently.

The workaround

Create a coach account and a separate athlete account, then connect them to each other. You train on the athlete side and review on the coach side.

This gives you the assistant, the daily priority list and feedback trends on your own training, which is genuinely useful for spotting patterns you would otherwise talk yourself out of.

What it won’t do

augo does not write training plans, and it will not coach you. The assistant surfaces context and drafts messages; the judgement stays human. If what you want is an AI that prescribes your training, augo isn’t that product, and deliberately so.

If you’d rather work with a person, the augo coach directory lists coaches taking on athletes.

faqs.question: Is there a self-coached plan?
faqs.answer: Not as a separate product. Self-coached athletes create both a coach account and an athlete account and connect them. Coach pricing applies, and a single connected athlete falls inside the free tier.

faqs.question: Will augo write me a training plan?
faqs.answer: No. augo does not generate training plans, and there is no AI on the athlete side at all. It organises data, surfaces what needs attention, and helps a human coach act on it.
